headline: Open scriptable tools now package MD clustering, PAE scoring and docking evaluation
label: Structural Bioinformatics Software Tools
summary: Recent releases package established MD clustering, AlphaFold confidence and complex evaluation methods as open, scriptable components.
synthesis: The three items share a focus on packaging established structural analyses as open, scriptable components. VMDance brings MDANCE n-ary similarity clustering (NANI, HELM, eQual, DIVINE) and PRIME representative selection into VMD for molecular dynamics trajectories. ReactifpTM reimplements the actifpTM interface confidence score as a standalone Python tool that takes PAE and model outputs from AlphaFold 2 and 3. pdb_cpp unifies PDB parsing, interface analysis, SASA, and DockQ and TM-score evaluation in a C++ library with Python bindings. The contribution is therefore framed in terms of accessibility and integration of existing methods. The summaries do not report benchmarks against alternative implementations, so performance claims are not supported by these items.
